translations.web: But Yahweh has not given you a heart to know, eyes to see, and ears to hear, to this day.
translations.bsb: Yet to this day the LORD has not given you a mind to understand, eyes to see, or ears to hear.
translations.kjv: Yet the LORD hath not given you an heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.
translations.asv: but Jehovah hath not given you a heart to know, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.
